import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[][] CMB;
    static int[] cntA, cntB;
    static List<Long>[] PART, ZERO_PART;
    static char[] S;
    static int R, C, N;

    static void build_comb() {
        CMB = new long[N + 1][N + 1];
        for (int i = 0; i <= N; ++i) {
            CMB[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
                CMB[i][j] = CMB[i - 1][j - 1] + CMB[i - 1][j];
            }
        }
    }

    static long calc_diff(int cfg, int a_cnt, int b_cnt) {
        long res = 0;
        long t1, t2;

        for (int k = 0; k < C + 1; ++k) {
            if ((cfg & (1 << k)) != 0) {
                ++b_cnt;
                t1 = CMB[b_cnt - 1][R - 1];
                t2 = CMB[N - b_cnt][R] - CMB[a_cnt][R];
                res -= t1 * t2;
            } else {
                ++a_cnt;
                t1 = CMB[a_cnt - 1][R - 1];
                t2 = CMB[N - a_cnt][R] - CMB[b_cnt][R];
                res += t1 * t2;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }

    static boolean check_cfg(int cfg) {
        for (int k = 0; k < C + 1; ++k) {
            if (S[2 * R + C + k] == 'A' && ((cfg >> k) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (S[2 * R + C + k] == 'B' && ((cfg >> k) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void build_parts() {
        int max_cfg = 1 << (C + 1);
        PART = new List[N + 2];
        ZERO_PART = new List[N + 2];
        for (int i = 0; i <= N + 1; ++i) {
            PART[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            ZERO_PART[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }

        for (int cfg = 0; cfg < max_cfg; ++cfg) {
            int b_cnt = Integer.bitCount(cfg);
            int a_cnt = C + 1 - b_cnt;

            if (check_cfg(cfg)) {
                PART[a_cnt].add(calc_diff(cfg, R + C - a_cnt, R + C - b_cnt));
            } else {
                ZERO_PART[a_cnt].add(calc_diff(cfg, R + C - a_cnt, R + C - b_cnt));
            }
        }

        for (int k = 0; k <= C + 1; ++k) {
            Collections.sort(PART[k]);
            Collections.sort(ZERO_PART[k]);
        }
    }

    static long get_mult(int cfg) {
        int i, j;

        for (i = 0; i < C + 1; ++i) {
            if (((cfg >> i) & 1) != (cfg & 1)) {
                break;
            }
        }

        for (j = i; j < C + 1; ++j) {
            if (S[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'A' && (((cfg >> j) & 1) == 1)) return 0;
            if (S[2 * R - 1 + j] == 'B' && (((cfg >> j) & 1) == 0)) return 0;
        }

        int set_a = R - 1 + ((cfg & 1) == 0 ? i : 0);
        int set_b = R - 1 + ((cfg & 1) == 1 ? i : 0);

        if (set_a < cntA[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (set_b < cntB[2 * R - 2 + i]) return 0;
        return CMB[set_a + set_b - cntA[2 * R - 2 + i] - cntB[2 * R - 2 + i]][set_a - cntA[2 * R - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void update(Pair best, Pair cand) {
        if (cand.first < 0) cand.first = -cand.first;

        if (best.first < cand.first) return;
        if (best.first > cand.first) {
            best.first = cand.first;
            best.second = cand.second;
            return;
        }
        best.second += cand.second;
    }

    static long count_val(List<Long> v, long val) {
        int lo = Collections.binarySearch(v, val);
        if (lo < 0) lo = -lo - 1;
        int hi = lo;
        while (hi < v.size() && v.get(hi).equals(val)) {
            hi++;
        }
        return hi - lo;
    }

    static long solve_part() {
        int max_cfg = 1 << (C + 1);
        Pair best = new Pair(1L << 60, 0);

        for (int cfg = 0; cfg < max_cfg; ++cfg) {
            int b_cnt = Integer.bitCount(cfg);
            int a_cnt = C + 1 - b_cnt;
            long cur = calc_diff(cfg, R - 1, R - 1);

            long mult = get_mult(cfg);
            List<Long> partList = PART[C + 1 - a_cnt];
            int idx = Collections.binarySearch(partList, -cur);
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;

            if (idx < partList.size()) {
                long val = partList.get(idx);
                if (best.first >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long mult2 = count_val(partList, val);
                    update(best, new Pair(val + cur, mult * mult2));
                }
            }

            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                long val = partList.get(idx);
                if (best.first >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long mult2 = count_val(partList, val);
                    update(best, new Pair(val + cur, mult * mult2));
                }
            }

            mult = 0;
            List<Long> zeroList = ZERO_PART[C + 1 - a_cnt];
            idx = Collections.binarySearch(zeroList, -cur);
            if (idx < 0) idx = -idx - 1;

            if (idx < zeroList.size()) {
                long val = zeroList.get(idx);
                if (best.first >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long mult2 = count_val(zeroList, val);
                    update(best, new Pair(val + cur, mult * mult2));
                }
            }

            if (idx > 0) {
                idx--;
                long val = zeroList.get(idx);
                if (best.first >= Math.abs(val + cur)) {
                    long mult2 = count_val(zeroList, val);
                    update(best, new Pair(val + cur, mult * mult2));
                }
            }
        }

        return best.second;
    }

    static class Pair {
        long first;
        long second;

        Pair(long f, long s) {
            first = f;
            second = s;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line1 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        R = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        C = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        S = (" " + br.readLine()).toCharArray();
        N = 2 * (R + C);

        cntA = new int[N + 1];
        cntB = new int[N + 1];

        build_comb();

        for (int i = 1; i <= N; ++i) {
            cntA[i] = cntA[i - 1] + (S[i] == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i] = cntB[i - 1] + (S[i] == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }

        build_parts();
        long ans = solve_part();
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
